name: central quartic potential in 2D, the symplectic Euler assignments in the other order

claims.why: TRAP (step semantics): drift first, then kick. Because the kick reads the NEW q, this is the adjoint symplectic Euler method, not explicit Euler (explicit Euler needs temporaries, see central-quartic-explicit-euler, REFUTED). By hand: q' = q + h p, p' = p - h k|q'|^2 q', so q' x p' = q' x p = (q + h p) x p = q x p
TRAP: the angular momentum with one sign flipped
exactly conserved, so conserved to every order (explicit Euler fails at p = 2)
